meta.name: prisma-database-setup
meta.description: Guides for configuring Prisma with different database providers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, etc.). Use when setting up a new project, changing databases, or troubleshooting connection issues. Triggers on "configure postgres", "connect to mysql", "setup mongodb", "sqlite setup".

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在项目初期需要配置Prisma连接数据库
copy.tagline_en: Configure Prisma to connect to various databases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure Prisma for your project's database connection

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 按 Prisma 官方流程帮你配置所选数据库:确定连接串、驱动适配器,并生成 Prisma Client;若是 MongoDB,则改用 Prisma 6.x 的专属流程。
howto.when: 当用户提到“configure postgres”等配置数据库关键词,或要求新建项目、排查连接问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 PostgreSQL 接入 Prisma。
say.note: 会给出 PostgreSQL schema 和适配器设置。

say.text: 数据库从 MySQL 换成 SQLite 该怎么改?
say.note: 会指导修改 datasource 等配置。

say.text: 怎么在 MongoDB 项目里配置 Prisma?
say.note: 会结合 MongoDB 专用流程给步骤。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude follows the official Prisma workflow to configure your chosen database: setting the connection string, choosing a driver adapter, and generating Prisma Client. For MongoDB, it keeps you on the Prisma 6.x-specific workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like "configure postgres", or asks for a new Prisma project or connection troubleshooting.

say_en.text: How do I switch my database from MySQL to SQLite?
How do I configure Prisma for a MongoDB project?
